page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5 family, utilizing the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated physical CPU cores with a single thread per core configuration, paired with 224.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For accelerated workloads, this instance includes two NVIDIA P100 GPUs providing a combined 32 GB of VRAM. Local storage is bundled as a 944 GB SSD, and network performance is anchored by a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

The hardware profile is optimized for parallel computing tasks that benefit from dedicated CPU cores and hardware acceleration. The qualitative cost efficiency of this instance reflects its legacy GPU architecture and high resource density, making it suitable for workloads such as deep learning training, scientific simulations, GPU-accelerated databases, and video transcoding.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel computing workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, it features 56 dedicated physical CPU cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio and 224.0 GB of system memory. The hardware configuration includes two integrated NVIDIA P100 GPUs with a total of 32 GB of VRAM, alongside a 944 GB local SSD for high-speed storage. Network connectivity is supported by a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth. This combination of dedicated compute resources, local SSD storage, and dual GPUs makes the instance suitable for workloads such as deep learning, scientific computing, and GPU-accelerated database operations.
